ai_visibility_ai_visibility.question: What is AI visibility?
ai_visibility_ai_visibility.answer: AI visibility is the extent to which AI assistants mention, cite and accurately describe your brand when answering questions relevant to your business. It is the AI-era equivalent of share of search.

ai_visibility_track_ai_visibility.question: How do you track AI visibility?
ai_visibility_track_ai_visibility.answer: We maintain a fixed prompt set covering your category, competitors, locations and buying questions, run it monthly across the major assistants, and record mentions, citations, sentiment and sources.

ai_visibility_why_results_vary.question: Why do results vary between runs?
ai_visibility_why_results_vary.answer: Assistants are non-deterministic and personalise by region and account. We control for this by using consistent settings, running multiple samples per prompt and reporting trends rather than single results.

ai_visibility_i_track_ai.question: Can I track AI visibility myself?
ai_visibility_i_track_ai.answer: You can spot-check manually, and you should. Systematic tracking across hundreds of prompts, several engines and multiple months is where a managed service saves time and produces reliable trends.

ai_visibility_good_mention_rate.question: What is a good mention rate?
ai_visibility_good_mention_rate.answer: It depends on category density. In niche B2B categories, 40–60% of relevant prompts is achievable; in crowded consumer categories, any consistent presence against national brands is meaningful progress.

ai_visibility_ai_visibility_correlate.question: Does AI visibility correlate with traffic?
ai_visibility_ai_visibility_correlate.answer: Partly. Some answers produce clicks, many produce brand awareness without a click. We pair visibility metrics with branded search volume and direct traffic to capture the full effect.

ai_visibility_quickly_visibility_improve.question: How quickly can visibility improve?
ai_visibility_quickly_visibility_improve.answer: Fixes to retrieval and accuracy can show within weeks. Competitive prompts where established publications dominate typically need three to six months of content and authority work.

ai_visibility_track_ai_overviews.question: Do you track AI Overviews too?
ai_visibility_track_ai_overviews.answer: Yes. Google AI Overviews are tracked alongside the assistants, including whether your domain is one of the linked sources.

ai_visibility_which_competitors_benchmar.question: Which competitors do you benchmark?
ai_visibility_which_competitors_benchmar.answer: We benchmark against up to three named competitors of your choice plus whichever brands the engines actually cite most, which is often not who you expect.

ai_visibility_monthly_report_include.question: What does the monthly report include?
ai_visibility_monthly_report_include.answer: Prompt-level results, trend charts for mention and citation rate, competitor share of answer, accuracy and sentiment notes, the sources engines used, and a prioritised action list.
